title: Rebuild the Seedance 2.0 skill from the Higgsfield director skill
description: Our Seedance 2.0 guide and recipe come from ten community blog posts; the vendor-skill step (docs/recipes/playbook/08-vendor-prompt-skills.md) was deferred while Seedance sat outside v1.0 and never run after MPI-853 shipped it. Fabio supplied Higgsfield's Seedance director skill, built from thousands of production generations, and names it the more accurate source (kept out of git: .agents/mpi-kanban/private/seedance-skills/, with the ACTING, LIRA and prompt-builder-2-5 skills beside it). It disagrees with ours where it matters: lens by diagonal field of view in degrees, never mm or f-stops; a short optional quality suffix, not a long mandatory one; first-frame occupancy, spatial blocking, gaze and landmark locks; lighting as a lock; minimal identity anchors per reference; local positive locks over negative blocks. Heal via /create-enhancer-recipe: rewrite recipe modes and docs/agent/models/seedance-2.0 in our own words (third-party text, never shipped verbatim), record adopted and rejected conventions with reasons, and compare against the top GitHub Seedance skills. Every agent doc stays <= 200 lines, so this model becomes a folder of skills behind one router (MPI-903 adds the folder support). Depends on MPI-903.
